title: The server chat dedup reads only the last two rows' roles, so an identical resend while the first turn runs gets a second answer
evidence: Fixed (US-15 AC63): claimChatTurn in app/lib/chat-dedup.server.ts re-serves a finished reply first, then claims (scope, message) in single_use_claims (kind chat-turn, HMAC key, TTL 180 s, released at turn end, fails open); web answers 409 busy, Discord stays silent. Both call sites (api.chat.ts, discord-bot.server.ts) go through it.
